items.title: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
items.description: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang. It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.

items.title: AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular in every poll
items.description: Poll data released Tuesday by the New York Times and Siena University confirms what we've already been seeing, and what politicians are responding to - AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular. items.title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
